title: Felix and the Vow
author: Astrid Winterbourne
blurb: Ansel Vasquez, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
